title: A Rainbow Between Showers
description: Move through rain-washed archways, choosing low jumps or diagonal launches to fit the openings.

signs.text: Small jumps fit beneath the rain arches
Rise with the spray · leave through the side opening
Launch diagonally between the arch crowns
The arch height changes the jump you need
Change direction around the garden’s high arches
Carry the spray’s lift into the final dry landing
